    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    BackToMenuEvent
    Represents a game event for returning to the main menu.
    Board
    Defines the contract for a game board in a block-stacking game like Tetris.
    Brick
    Defines the contract for a Tetris brick.
    BrickFactory
    A factory class for creating different types of Tetris bricks.
    BrickGenerator
    Defines the contract for generating Tetris bricks.
    BrickRotator
    Manages the rotation state and current shape of a Tetris brick.
    BrickType
    An enumeration of the standard Tetris brick types.
    ClearRow
    Represents the result of clearing one or more rows from the game board.
    Command
    Represents a command that can be executed.
    DownData
    An immutable data class that encapsulates the result of a brick's downward movement, potentially including information about cleared rows and updated view data.
    DownEvent
    Represents a game event for moving the current brick down.
    DropDownCommand
    A command that moves the current brick on the board down by one row.
    EventSource
    Defines the possible sources of a game event.
    EventType
    Defines the types of movement events that can occur in the game.
    GameBoardRenderer
    Renders the Tetris game board and the falling bricks onto a JavaFX GridPane.
    GameController
    The main controller for the game logic.
    GameEvent
    Represents a generic game event.
    GameFlowController
    Manages the game flow, including the main game loop, timers, scoring, and game state transitions.
    GameInfoPanelController
    Controller for the game information panel, responsible for displaying the player's score, current level, and a preview of the next falling brick.
    GameMode
    An enumeration of the available game modes.
    GameModeController
    Controller for the game mode selection screen.
    GameOverPanel
    A custom JavaFX BorderPane designed to display a Game Over or Victory message.
    GuiController
    The main controller for the Graphical User Interface (GUI).
    HardDropCommand
    A command that performs a "hard drop" on the current brick, moving it down as far as possible.
    HardDropEvent
    Represents a game event for performing a "hard drop" on the current brick.
    InputEventListener
    Defines the contract for an event listener that responds to user input and game events related to brick movements and game state changes.
    InputHandler
    Handles user input from keyboard events and translates them into game actions.
    ISoundManager
    Defines the contract for a sound manager.
    LeftEvent
    Represents a game event for moving the current brick to the left.
    Main
    Main class for the TetrisJFX application.
    MainMenuController
    Controller for the main menu of the Tetris game.
    MatrixOperations
    A utility class containing static methods for performing various operations on 2D integer matrices, primarily used for game board and brick manipulations in a Tetris-like game.
    MoveEvent
    An immutable data class that encapsulates a movement event in the game.
    MoveLeftCommand
    A command that moves the current brick on the board to the left by one column.
    MoveRightCommand
    A command that moves the current brick on the board to the right by one column.
    NewGameEvent
    Represents a game event for starting a new game.
    NextShapeInfo
    An immutable data class that holds information about a brick's shape and its rotational position.
    NotificationPanel
    A custom JavaFX BorderPane used to display transient notifications such as score bonuses or "GAME OVER" messages.
    ParticleEffect
    Manages and renders particle effects within the game, specifically for line clear explosions.
    RandomBrickGenerator
    Implements the BrickGenerator interface to provide a random sequence of Tetris bricks.
    RightEvent
    Represents a game event for moving the current brick to the right.
    RotateCommand
    A command that rotates the current brick on the board.
    RotateEvent
    Represents a game event for rotating the current brick.
    Score
    Represents the player's score in the game.
    SettingsController
    Controller for the settings menu.
    SimpleBoard
    Implements the Board interface, providing the core game logic for Tetris.
    SoundManager
    Manages all sound effects and background music for the game.
    ViewData
    An immutable data class that holds all the necessary information for rendering the current state of the game board and its elements.
